_comment: 1987 賽季導言 facts pack。每個 verified:true 的 claim 由 scripts/check-season-intros.py 內建查詢對 data/f1/db.sqlite 重查驗證；導言中每個阿拉伯數字與順位詞都必須落在本檔 verified claims 的 anchors 內。external_history 屬常識性歷史背景、不進機械對帳。

claims.source: sqlite: SELECT 1 FROM seasons WHERE year=1987

claims.text: 皮凱（Nelson Piquet）以 73 分作收奪冠
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1987 AND position=1
sqlite: SELECT wins FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1987 AND position=1（並以 results 逐站重算對照）
sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_standings WHERE driver_id='piquet' AND position=1 AND season<=1987

claims.text: 曼塞爾（Nigel Mansell）以 61 分居年度第二
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1987 AND position=2

claims.text: 塞納（Ayrton Senna）年度順位第三
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT position FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1987 AND driver_id='senna'

claims.text: 威廉斯車隊全季拿下 9 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE season=1987 AND constructor_id='williams' AND position_text='1'
